Kick-Start Program

This Program aims to kick start your journey as a professional coach by taking your gift, voice, and genius out to the world. 

You will master the healthy coach mindset to enable and empower you with clarity and focus as you lay the foundations for your coaching business.

Learn how to position yourself to deliver profound value to those you serve.

YOU ARE A COACH. NOW WHAT? This program is brought to you in partnership with Frustrated that people don't understand what coaching is and how you can help them? Learn how to market who you are to find ideal clients who will willingly trust you and the coaching process. The next intake begins in Sep 2022, and there are two different time slots to choose from: 3 pm Singapore OR 8 pm Singapore. Module A: 8 & 9 Sep I Module B: 14 & 15 Sep I Module C: 21 & 22 Sep Participation Fee: USD 795 NETT

This Program helps you overcome your limiting beliefs and roadblocks by teaching you how to market who you are so that you can find ideal clients that will willingly trust you and the coaching process. 

What can you expect to take away?

1. You can articulate with clarity and confidence: Who You Are - Who You Serve - Why You Do it - What Problem You Help Them Solve - What You Can Do 

2. You know how to attract clients that will willingly trust you and the coaching process

3. You learn how to overcome objections and get their "Yes."

4. You know how to maximise your impact

About the Facilitator: Mick Spiers

Mick Spiers is the founder and CEO of The Leadership Project. He is an experienced executive with a strong track record in developing exceptional high-performance teams. He is a professional marketer who wants to help coaches better market and position themselves to maximise their impact.
